stories.title: Provider Detail Response Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define canonical response schema for provider details aligned to NPI Registry fields and Pydantic validation patterns used in application tool models.

stories.title: NPI Registry Lookup Core Logic
stories.description: Implement service logic to query CMS NPI Registry API, parse response, and normalize provider attributes including specialty, license status, address, phone, and enumeration date.

stories.title: Evaluate Care Facade Integration
stories.description: Integrate provider detail service into EvaluateCare facade to enable orchestrated retrieval and exposure to tool router flows.

stories.title: Tool/API Exposure for Provider Detail Lookup
stories.description: Expose provider detail lookup via tool router with validated inputs (NPI or provider identifier) and structured output for chat consumption.

stories.title: Provider Detail Lookup Tests and Validation
stories.description: Develop unit and integration tests validating NPI lookup, field mapping accuracy, schema contract adherence, and error handling (invalid NPI, missing data) across service, facade, and tool layers.
